name: Patchwork Zombie Hulk
description: A towering gestalt of corpses moving as one, with torso-sized limbs and fists as large as a grown halfling.

abilities.name: Destructible
abilities.description: When the Zombie takes Major or greater damage, they mark an additional HP.

abilities.name: Flailing Limbs
abilities.description: When the Zombie makes a standard attack, they can attack all targets within Very Close range.

abilities.name: Another for the Pile
abilities.description: When the Zombie is within Very Close range of a corpse, they can incorporate it into themselves, clearing a HP and a Stress.

abilities.name: Tormented Screams
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to cause all PCs within Far range to make a Presence Reaction Roll (13). Targets who fail lose a Hope and you gain a Fear for each. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.
